name: characters-chat-reliability
title: Repair characters and chat entry reliability
description: Plan WebView/page-entry reliability, CORS fixes and bounded long-conversation history reads, including prompt TOAST diagnosis and a compatible display read model

creator: cline
notes: 2026-11-11: Added R9/AC13-16/B3 after read-only Sentry, Railway and production Supabase catalog research. Include independent prompt detoast A/B diagnosis; local Docker/psql unavailable, no benchmark result yet. Planning only; no product code, migrations, remote writes or task start. Latest expanded plan still requires implementation review. Preserve existing task identity and unrelated workspace changes. User confirmed R10 / AC17-20 hard gates: no page or reply performance regression, complete visible history without missing records, unchanged reading/interaction experience and existing functionality. This is planning clarification, not implementation approval. Design review: existing chat_generation_requests and begin_chat_generation_observation provide a reuse candidate. New metadata table/parsing trigger is provisional; benchmark read-only reuse and confirm AC14 boundaries before final implementation planning. R10 hard gates unchanged. User then requested combining both approaches. Authoritative B3 plan is research/history-combined-design.md: bounded page-key selection plus complete display projection, reuse actual atomic admission writer and request identity, cheap invalidation for legacy writers (no stored-history parsing trigger), bounded legacy backfill including earliest-page opening, related-path consumer audit and DB-write recovery. AC14 is retained, AC21 adds combined completion criteria. Supersedes the earlier provisional read-only-first/table decision. Planning only; not implementation approval.

benchmark.source: Planned synthetic PG17 10/100/1000/10000-turn matrix and ordinary-column / history element / full snapshot / scalar projection comparison; >=100 samples per group with controlled payload, revision, inheritance and cache conditions
benchmark.limitation: Docker and psql unavailable in current PATH; not run. No production business-row query, EXPLAIN ANALYZE or load test authorized.

hard_acceptance.full_history: All records visible under existing ownership, deletion, revision and inheritance semantics remain accessible through existing pagination, with no new total-history cap or content truncation.
hard_acceptance.experience: Preserve pagination entry/page size, scroll position, loaded content on failure, drafts, session isolation, keyboard and streaming interactions. No full-history or backfill prerequisite to page readiness or normal sending.
hard_acceptance.measurement: Matched old/new device/platform, network, dataset, cache and original clocks. Separate Android/iOS, cold/SPA and ordinary/long cohorts; test ordinary chat, generation concurrent with pagination and generation concurrent with backfill. Existing mixed-release aggregates are not matched baselines.
hard_acceptance.source: User requirements confirmed 2026-11-11; prd.md R10/AC17-20. Missing baselines are null; requirements and targets are not measured results.
hard_acceptance.window: Controlled paired runs with >=100 samples per group; release validation >=24h and >=100 successful foreground samples per platform/route/cohort. Insufficient samples or unresolved noise remain unverified. Real-provider timing requires same provider/model cohorts; local stubs do not establish production performance.
hard_acceptance.stop_condition: Do not switch while hard gates are unverified or failing. Confirmed content/function/performance regression stops rollout/backfill and retains or restores the old read path; the earlier 20 percent alert does not permit regression.

combined_design.completion: New and legacy visible history, initial/deep/earliest pages; valid projection coverage and no fallback in release cohort. Uncovered scope remains incomplete.
combined_design.write_budget: Atomic writer plus invalidation cost included in matched preparation/first-visible/write P95; all no-regression gates remain.
combined_design.recovery: Read-path rollback and separately rehearsed DB write-maintenance rollback; application rollback alone does not undo DB changes.

mobile_performance.notes: Top-level Android/iOS baseline refers specifically to chat SPA; route-specific metrics are not averaged. API baseline is the saved client conversation_detail GET success P95, distinct from new server_get spans. No visible long-conversation or per-platform API/DB P95: null, never zero. iOS chat N=75 is low sample. Goals are engineering targets, not measured attainment. Monitor errors/stalls/timeouts/retries/fallback/coverage and generation writes; no release or remote write in this task turn.
